**sdd/issue-239-a3/apply-progress**

**What**: Phase 1 (PR-1, merged) tasks 1.1-1.14 — labelEvents verb + m3 close + actor-check/brain-writes-reviewed CLI-hardcoding fixes + prReviews verb + regression guard. DONE (1169/1169 tests, 395/400 non-test diff).

Phase 2 (PR-2, merged) tasks 2.1-2.6 — GitLab prView/mrCreate un-stub over gitlabApiFetch. DONE (1178/1178 tests, 116/400 non-test diff). See prior revisions for full Phase 1/2 detail.

Phase 3 + Phase 4.1 (PR-3, branch feat/issue-239-a3-pr3, based on feature/v2.0.0=d4b64e5 which has PR-1+PR-2 merged) — tasks 3.1-3.7 + 4.1 — shared parameterized contract suite + recorded/DERIVED fixture infra + verb-definition reconciliation + body-parity fix. DONE, all 8 tasks [x]. This is the CP-A3a verdict tranche.

**FRESH-CONTEXT REVIEW FIX (same PR-3, applied after initial Phase 3 apply)**: a fresh-context review found the drift-guard from task 3.6 only reconciled 2 of the 3 promised sources (doc table ↔ VERBS), never checking the providers' ACTUAL exports — the real ground truth. Proven: the 2-source guard would have caught the historical `branchProtect` drift but NOT `mrCreate` (a verb both providers implement that could have been omitted from both the table and VERBS with nothing catching it). Fixed:
- `brain/scripts/vcs/verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs` — added `sharedFunctionExports(a, b)`: computes the intersection of function-typed exports from two provider-shaped objects, independent of any doc/array. Added `SHARED_NON_VERB_EXPORTS` (currently empty `Set` — `PROVIDER` never reaches it because the function-type filter excludes it first; `checkRuns` is github-only, not shared, so also not a candidate; reserved for future genuinely-shared non-verb exports, each entry must be documented inline). Added 2 new tests: (1) a FAKE-provider injection test (`{...github, ghostVerb: async()=>{}}` / `{...gitlab, ghostVerb: async()=>{}}`) proving the check flags an undeclared shared export — RED→GREEN proven by temporarily stubbing `sharedFunctionExports` to always return `[]` (ran `node --test` → 2 failures with `sanity: the injected shared export must be detected as shared`), then restoring the real implementation (ran again → 4/4 pass); (2) the REAL guard: `sharedFunctionExports(github, gitlab)` filtered against `VERBS ∪ SHARED_NON_VERB_EXPORTS` must be empty — passes today (16 shared functions, all in VERBS). Verified via a standalone script that replaying the pre-3.6 VERBS array (13 entries, missing mrCreate/branchProtect/capabilities) against the REAL current provider exports flags exactly `['branchProtect','capabilities','mrCreate']` — i.e. this third check is strictly stronger than the doc-vs-VERBS-only check and would have caught the exact drift class the reviewer named. File header comment updated to say "ALL THREE sources" (was "both sources").
- `brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md:61` — stale prose "exporting the 13 verbs" → "exporting the 15 verbs" (true count after task 3.6's prView/mrCreate row additions). Trivial fix only, no gold-plating (no automated count-assertion added, per explicit instruction).
- `openspec/changes/issue-239-a3/tasks.md` — added a "Fresh-context review addendum" note under task 3.6 documenting the third-check addition; added a new Open Questions entry for the DEFERRED issueView body-parity follow-up (see below) — code NOT touched for this, by design.

**DEFERRED (not code — tracked as a follow-up, per explicit instruction not to touch code)**: `gitlab.mjs#issueView`'s `body: r.description` was NOT given the `?? ''` treatment `prView` now has — issueView is outside the Phase-3 contract-suite scope (labelEvents/prView/mrCreate only). Verified ZERO current regression: the only real caller, `selectIssueLinkBody` (`brain/scripts/lib/audit-helpers.mjs:52-54`, `return (typeof prBody === 'string' && prBody.trim()) ? prBody : commitBody`), treats `null` and `''` identically (both fail the `typeof==='string' && .trim()` check and fall through to `commitBody`) — confirmed by reading the function directly. Tracked in tasks.md's Open Questions so the asymmetry isn't forgotten; explicitly NOT fixed now.

**Final state after the fresh-review fix**: 1196/1196 tests pass (was 1194; +2 new: the fake-provider detection test + the real-providers reconciliation test). `npm run brain:repo:check` and `npm run brain:nav` both green. Authoritative non-test counted diff (`git diff --cached --numstat | node brain/scripts/vcs/diff-size-count.mjs`): **325/400** (was 323; +2 from the vcs-contract.md prose fix — the new drift-guard tests and tasks.md addendum are excluded via `**/*.test.mjs` / `openspec/changes/**`). Well under budget, no ignoreList migration needed.

(See earlier revision of this observation, or PR-1/PR-2 for full Phase 1/2 file-level detail — this revision focuses on Phase 3 + the fresh-review fix to avoid re-duplicating already-recorded Phase 1/2 content.)

**Where** (Phase 3 files, full list): `brain/scripts/vcs/fixtures/record-fixtures.mjs` (new, committed, actually run live against `gh` for 2 recorded fixtures), `brain/scripts/vcs/fixtures/*.json` (12 files: 2 RECORDED from real GitHub API — `github-labelEvents-happy.json` from issue #239, `github-prView-happy.json` from PR #238 — 10 DERIVED with explicit reasons), `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs` (new, 14 tests, shared parameterized contract suite over `['github','gitlab']`), `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs` (task 3.7: `prView` body `?? ''`), `brain/scripts/vcs/cli.mjs` (VERBS gains mrCreate/branchProtect/capabilities), `brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md` (Required-verbs table gains mrCreate/prView rows + 15-verb count fix, L6 gate), `brain/scripts/vcs/verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs` (new, 4 tests, now reconciles ALL THREE verb-contract sources).

**PLAN-DEVIATIONS (all recorded)**: (1) GitLab live-mirror recording unreachable in this environment — all gitlab-*.json fixtures derived, folds into CP-A3b/SCIT; (2) mrCreate happy-path recording refused for BOTH providers (would require opening a real live PR as a fixture-maintenance side effect); (3) issueView body left unchanged in Phase 3 (out of contract-suite scope) — now formally tracked as an Open Question follow-up per the fresh review; (4) `capabilities` added to VERBS but not the Required-verbs table (matches exact task 3.6 text), documented as an explicit `DOCUMENTED_BUT_NOT_REQUIRED` exception in the drift guard.

All 8 Phase 3/4.1 tasks marked [x] in tasks.md. Phase 4.2 (memory:share) and 4.3 (CP-A3a PR assembly/STOP declaration) remain explicitly DEFERRED to the orchestrator.
